title: Developer GitHub Workspace Projection v1
description: Content-light projection of the developer GitHub workspace. Reflects installation identity, repository discovery/intake lifecycle, and publication readiness. No raw installation tokens, file contents, prompts, private code, or secrets. Safe for Gridline frontend consumption, WebSocket streaming, and evidence capture.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier for this projection shape.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the projection was generated.

connection.description: Content-light installation identity and auth state. No raw installation tokens or secrets. Null when no GitHub App installation is connected.

installation_id_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the GitHub App installation ID.

connection_state.description: Current state of the GitHub App installation connection.

token_available.description: Whether an installation access token is currently available.

token_expires_in_seconds.description: Seconds until the installation access token expires, if available.

accessible_repository_count.description: Number of repositories accessible to this installation.

permissions_summary.description: Map of permission name to permission level (e.g. read, write) for this installation.

errors.description: Installation-level error messages encountered during connection.

repositories.description: Repository descriptors discovered from the GitHub App installation. Contains public metadata only — clone URLs are anonymous (never tokenized).

repository_hash.description: Content-light SHA256 identity digest computed from owner/name.

full_name.description: Full repository slug in owner/name format.

description_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the repository description, or null if no description.

visibility.description: Repository visibility as reported by GitHub.

has_pages.description: Whether GitHub Pages is available for this repository.

clone_url.description: Anonymous HTTPS clone URL. Never tokenized.

intake_state.description: Intake lifecycle state for local workspace import.

selected.description: Whether the developer has selected this repository for local intake.

analyzable.description: Whether this repository is eligible for code analysis.

pushed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent push to the repository, or null if unknown.

total_discovered.description: Total number of repositories discovered from the installation.

selected_count.description: Number of repositories currently selected for local intake.

imported_count.description: Number of repositories successfully imported into the local workspace.

analyzed_count.description: Number of repositories that have completed code analysis.

publishable_count.description: Number of repositories eligible for GitHub Pages publication.
